newsitem.title: USA: Vital Signs has contract with Premier.
newsitem.headline: Vital Signs has contract with Premier.

text.p: Vital Signs Inc said Monday it has a dual source agreement with Premier, the nation's largest healthcare alliance enterprise, for a broad range of anesthesia products, including breathing circuits and face masks.

Part of Premier's group purchasing commitment program, the agreement features savings for Premier hospitals and systems which agree to buy 90 percent of the products covered in the agreement from Vital Signs or one other supplier.
Pricing for the five-year agreement is effective February 1, 1997.

Premier resulted from the merger earlier this year of the former American Healthcare Systems Inc, SunHealth Alliance Inc and Premier Health Alliance Inc. The new Premier serves its 250 owners, the 700 hospitals and healthcare facilities they operate, and about 1,100 other affiliated hospital and healthcare organizations.
